contract: one MPEG-TS input (TS188 or M2TS192) of authored synthetic streams, preloaded and read forward only, for one selected program

candidate: the public API only. TransportStream parses the input and selects the program; its first active PMT binds a compat::pes::DemuxObserver to the program's one elementary stream with the constructor its carriage selects, the transport packets of that PID feed the observer, and compat::pes::DemuxClock places each packet's timestamps

reference: FFmpeg's mpegts demuxer through custom AVIO (32 KiB buffer, reads of at most 64 KiB) with NOPARSE and NOFILLIN, no stream discovery and no decoders; every packet of the selected program in demuxer order

each packet folds stream index, PID, PTS and DTS in 90 kHz units (absent as INT64_MIN), duration, position, flags, payload length and bytes, and every side-data element (type, size, bytes); program and stream metadata are not compared

a case passes only when both reach EOF and both folds equal the expected fold recorded from the reference worker on the pinned build; those expected folds also equal the folds of the archived reference observations of the same inputs

a context the observer alone cannot take ends the operation with its cause and fails the case: a program without exactly one stream of a supported carriage, a later PMT, a clock or format boundary, a quarantined clock, a transport, PES-time, program or active PSI fault, a carrier the observer rejects, and a second media entity; an operation that finishes without a packet fails as an empty observation, because the program-level outcome is not compared

the recorded 272-request set is replayed as these 97 compat-view operations (104 of the requests are compat-view requests): requests with the same inputs, packet size, program and declared descriptor namespace (--dvb) are one operation and share a case. The 168 requests for the strict source view, 64 of them for its native source-clock projection, are replayed as the compat-view operation on their inputs; the strict source view itself is not compared. corpus.json lists every request under its case

requests over two media entities (a second segment, optionally after a discontinuity) stay cases without an expected fold: the candidate refuses at the entity boundary and the reference has no single-input equivalent
pending_module_requirements: a published MPEG-TS ContainerReader: program-level PAT/PMT routing, clock and format boundaries, recovery of rejected and damaged carriers, and input across media entities
